old-wrap-reader.title: gripfrond wrap
lines: Wear the wrap over your hands for one point of
armor on covered hands. Tough folded fronds bend
around the fingers without splitting along their
edges.
USE & MECHANICS
Armor value (AV): +1.
Dodge value (DV): +0.
AV protects a struck body location, not the whole
body.
Equip slots: Handwear.
Tactical use: Wear the wraps and brace beside a
solid handhold against one physical shove or pull.
The stance lasts three of your turns; moving ends
it. Damage, spells and teleportation are not
blocked. Choose its inventory action while in
reach; success costs one action.
Type: Item
